items.title: Objection deadline (Einspruch) against tax assessment
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated 27.12.2024 (Friday). It was posted before 1 January 2025, so the transitional PostModG rule applies (as also stated in the letter itself): the notice counts as delivered on the 3rd day after posting, i.e. 27.12.2024 + 3 days = 30.12.2024 (Monday). This is a tax authority notice (§ 122 Abs. 2 AO), so if that 3rd day fell on a weekend/holiday it would move to the next working day under § 108 Abs. 3 AO — but 30.12.2024 is a normal Monday, so no shift is needed; delivery is deemed 30.12.2024. The one-month objection period under § 355 Abs. 1 AO / § 108 Abs. 1 AO with §§ 187, 188 BGB starts the next day and ends on the day in the following month with the same date number: 30.01.2025. That date is a Thursday and not a public holiday in NW, so it stands as the final day.

items.title: Annual motor vehicle tax collected by direct debit
items.quote: Die Steuer wird jährlich im Voraus durch Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: The tax of 186,00 € is set 'ab 01.01.2025' and is stated to be collected annually in advance by direct debit ('jährlich im Voraus durch Lastschrift eingezogen'), but the letter gives no specific calendar date for the debit. The earliest plausible date tied to the start of liability is the term start itself, 01.01.2025; no exact collection date can be confirmed from the text.

warnings: The letter does not specify the exact calendar date on which the annual direct debit for the 186,00 € vehicle tax will be executed, only that it is collected 'jährlich im Voraus' from 01.01.2025; the person should verify their account for the debit around the start of each tax year.

No separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated, so the document date (27.12.2024) was used as the posting date; if the actual posting date differed, the delivery date and thus the one-month Einspruch deadline (30.01.2025) would shift accordingly.
